text:
Comments received and responses for the corridor location and environmental public hearings and for the Draft Environmental Impact Statement are contained in this Final Environmental Impact Statement.
This Final Environmental Impact Statement is written to comply with the provisions of the National Environmental Policy Act of 1969 and the Wisconsin State Environmental Policy Act of 1972.
A separate Air Quality Report assessing the air quality impact of the proposed facility has been reviewed and approved by the Indirect Source Review Agency, (Department of Natural Resources). This assessment meets the requirements of Wisconsin Administration Code NR 154.05.
